title: A Proclamation to Approve the Loan Agreement Between the Government of Eritrea and the Arab Bank for Economic Development in Africa 99/1997
text:
Proclamation No.99/1997
A Proclamation to Approve the Loan
Agreement between the Government of
Eritrea and the Arab Bank for Economic
Development in Africa
WHEREAS, a Loan Agreement between the Government of Eritrea and the Arab
Bank for Economic Development in Africa, stipulating that the Arab Bank for
Economic Development in Africa provide to the Government of Eritrea a loan
amounting to US Dollar ten million (10,000.000. =) to assist in the financing of the
Asmara Town Water Supply Project was signed at Khartoum, Sudan, on the 18th of
July, 1997; and
WHEREAS, the Loan Agreement has been ratified by the President of the State of
Eritrea;
NOW, THEREFORE, in accordance with Article 6(4) (c) of the Definition of
Powers and Duties of the Government of Eritrea Proclamation No.37/1993, it is
hereby proclaimed as follows: -
1. Short Title
This Proclamation may be cited as the "Arab Bank for Economic Development in
Africa Loan Agreement to assist in the Financing of the Asmara Town Water
Supply Project Approval Proclamation No.99/1997".
2. Definition
In this Proclamation "Loan Agreement” means the Loan Agreement signed at
Khartoum, Sudan, on the 18th of July, 1997, between the Government of Eritrea
and the Arab Bank for Economic Development in Africa.
3. Power of the Ministers of Finance and Land, Water and Environment
The Ministers of Finance and Land, Water and Environment are hereby jointly
and severally empowered to undertake all acts for the utilization of the loan
amounting to US Dollars ten million (US$ 10,000,000. =) in accordance with the
terms and conditions set forth in the Loan Agreement.
4. Effective Date
This Proclamation shall enter into force on the date of its publication in the
Gazette of Eritrean Laws.
Done at Asmara, this 28th day of October 1997.
Issaias Afwerki,
President of the State of Eritrea.
